text:
Type: white ornate picture frame
Use: displaying a photo or print on a wall, sideboard, shelf or desk; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: classic, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: molded frame with a white painted finish, raised beaded border, white mat, clear front panel
Colors: white, soft off-white mat
Shape: portrait rectangle with a stepped profile and a row of small pearl-like beads framing the mat, delicate detail, medium visual weight
Feel: romantic, charming, soft, elegant
Goes with: family photos, vintage prints, pastel walls, white painted furniture; classic, cottage or farmhouse rooms

product.name: VIRSERUM
product.description: The mount enhances the picture and makes framing easy.
